text: Objective: Through study, students could learn and understand Chinese human geography, be familiar with Chinese customs, be proficient in tourism listening and tour guide oral, and be engaged in the basic work related to tourism. Characteristics: Simulation travel & small size & intership Courses: Practical Chinese Listening and Reading, Practical Comprehensive Chinese, Daily Chinese Conversation, Chinese Culture, Chinese Human Geography, Tourism Management, Travel Around China, Tour Guide Oral, and Tourism Listening etc. Notes: The program will open if the number of applicants are over 10 or above. It could accept group and individual registration. Group class could decide the study content and study time.
